# Transport manifest for #4974 item 3, cutover step 2 (docs/articles-generator-migration.md §5.2).
#
# One path or glob per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Every path here is resolved relative to the repo root and must exist at resolve
# time, or the workflow fails loudly (a stale entry is a silent scope shrink, not
# a warning).
#
# Why a file instead of inline YAML: this set is the actual reviewable content of
# the transport — a diff to this file is a diff to what moves, independent of any
# workflow-syntax changes.
#
# WHY THIS IS NOT "scripts/lib/**": scripts/lib/ has 792 files on disk, and most
# of them are the job-crawler feature's per-employer parsers (job-parser.mjs,
# ats-clients/**, alerts/**, most of perf-sources/**, most of topic-sources/**,
# most of evidence/**, scheduler/winnerEvaluator.mjs) — unrelated to article
# generation and NOT part of the MOVE set in docs/articles-generator-migration.md
# §2. A blanket glob would ship ~730 irrelevant files into nanako's tree. The list
# below is the actual static-import transitive closure of the 7 entry points,
# computed by following relative import/export/require specifiers from each
# producer (regex-based, same limitation the doc's §1 methodology notes: dynamic
# `import()` behind a computed path is invisible to this and was checked by hand
# for the entries below — verified no entry uses one for its own lib tree).
#
# The doc's §2 prose describes this set by directory group ("discovery/**,
# scoring/**, topic-sources/**, evidence/**, scheduler/**, etc.") as a shorthand.
# Taken literally that shorthand is wrong for topic-sources/, evidence/, and
# scheduler/: each of those directories has files NOT reachable from any of the
# 7 entries (e.g. scripts/lib/scheduler/winnerEvaluator.mjs is only imported by
# scripts/tune-discovery-quota.mjs, a maintenance script outside this move; see
# the migration report for the full verification). This manifest lists the real
# closure, not the shorthand, on the theory that an explicit file list that has
# been checked beats a glob that has not.
#
# discovery/** and scoring/** ARE fully covered by every file the resolver found
# under those two directories, so they're expressed as globs; the rest are listed
# file-by-file because only part of each directory is in scope.

# --- The 7 MOVE entry points (docs §2, §4, §5.2) ---------------------------
# 5 named producers, the 7th undercounted producer (fix-faq-locales.mjs, §4/§6.5),
# and its paired helper (generate-journalist-image-catalog.mjs, §2: "the six
# producers themselves plus the two helper scripts one of them shells out to /
# is paired with"). NOTE: docs §5 step 2's own prose lists only 6 (producers +
# fix-faq-locales.mjs) and omits generate-journalist-image-catalog.mjs — that is
# a discrepancy between §2 (MOVE) and §5's summary sentence, not a hidden STAYS.
# Included here per §2's explicit disposition; flagged in the migration report
# for the doc author to reconcile.
scripts/create-article.mjs
scripts/generate-events-digest-article.mjs
scripts/generate-border-wait-ranking-article.mjs
scripts/publish-journalist-article.mjs
scripts/batch-add-faq-to-articles.mjs
scripts/fix-faq-locales.mjs
scripts/generate-journalist-image-catalog.mjs

# NOTE — explicitly NOT moved, do not add:
# scripts/lib/resolve-git-add-path.mjs — resolves a repo-relative path through a
# symlink to its real on-disk path for `git add`. Only exists because main's
# corpus paths are symlinks into packages/articles/. Docs §2: "STAYS main-shaped,
# but nanako needs its own equivalent... retire on the nanako side, note it
# explicitly so nobody ports it out of habit." It IS in the static-import
# closure (create-article.mjs imports it) — it is excluded on purpose, not by
# oversight. Producer scripts landing in nanako will need this call site rewired
# to nanako's own (symlink-free) path resolution before they can run there; that
# rewiring is out of scope for this "stand up the code" step (§5.2) and belongs
# to the REWIRE work in §5.3+.

# --- discovery/** — topic discovery pipeline (fully reachable, safe to glob) --
scripts/lib/discovery/**

# --- scoring/** — dedup/scoring pipeline (fully reachable, safe to glob) ------
scripts/lib/scoring/**

# --- evidence/, scheduler/, perf-sources/, topic-sources/ ------------------
# Partially reachable: each of these directories also holds files used only by
# OTHER scripts (quality-alerts.mjs, tune-discovery-quota.mjs, the job-crawler
# feature, etc.) that are not part of this move. Listed file-by-file rather than
# globbed so the manifest doesn't silently widen if someone adds a new,
# unrelated file to one of these directories later.
scripts/lib/evidence/constants.mjs
scripts/lib/evidence/embeddingClient.mjs
scripts/lib/perf-sources/domainTerms.mjs
